## The quantities we report

**TODO**: define, in plain terms, each recurring quantity (with a forward link to its formal definition):

- **Words understood / spoken / signed** — counts out of a common 800-item checklist (@sec-betabinomial).
- **Production ratio $q(a)$** — the fraction of understood words a child also says (@sec-ratios).
- **Sign ratio $r(a)$** — the fraction of understood words a child also signs (@sec-ratios).
- **Within-understood association $\psi$** — whether signing and speaking a given understood word go together more than chance (@sec-association).
- **Total expressive vocabulary $p_{\text{any}}$** — words a child produces by speech or sign (@sec-association).
- **Rate of learning** — words gained per month, from the slope of the trajectory.
